feed.title: Free small-business calculators — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 1145 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 20 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: Boba Tea Shop Profit Calculator — Break-Even and Ramp-Up
entry.summary: Free pro forma for boba, bubble tea and specialty drink shops: profit per cup, break-even cups a day with the loan, the price for your target margin, delivery-app cost, and a 60-month ramp-up with the cash reserve you need. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Bowling Center Profit Calculator — Break-Even Utilization, Lanes, Payback
entry.summary: Free bowling center profit calculator: lanes, peak and off-peak lane-hour prices, utilization, leagues, parties and events, food and drink, staffing, rent and a loan become monthly profit, break-even lane utilization, the price change that hits a target margin, the ramp-up cash reserve and payback. Private, runs in your browser.

entry.title: cargo audit Triage — Which RustSec Advisories Does Your Rust Code Actually Use?
entry.summary: Paste cargo audit --json and your Rust source: see which flagged crates your code actually uses and which are test-only or unreferenced noise. Free cargo audit triage, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: CBAM Cost Estimator — What Will the EU Carbon Border Levy Cost on My Imports?
entry.summary: Free CBAM cost estimator for EU importers of steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers and hydrogen: embedded emissions, free-allocation phase-out 2026 to 2034, certificates needed, cost per tonne, and the 50-tonne threshold. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Convenience Store and Gas Station Profit Calculator — Fuel Margin After Card Fees
entry.summary: Free convenience store and gas station profit calculator: fuel margin after card fees, inside sales mix, labor and rent become monthly profit, break-even gallons, debt coverage and fuel margin sensitivity. Private, runs in your browser.

entry.title: DAC7 Seller Reporting Checker — Will Etsy, eBay, Vinted or Airbnb Report You?
entry.summary: Free DAC7 checker for online sellers and hosts: will the platform report your sales or rentals to the tax authority this year? Checks the 30-sales / EUR 2,000 goods exemption, headroom, what is sent and the TIN deadline. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Dry Cleaner Profit Calculator — Break-Even Pieces and Price Per Piece
entry.summary: Free dry cleaner profit calculator: pieces, price, supplies, claims, card fees, labor and rent become monthly profit, break-even pieces, the price increase that covers your costs and debt coverage. Private, runs in your browser.
